description: Create the weekly-sales-report edge function that sends a full team comparison to admins and individual reports to each salesperson. Includes week-over-week comparison, top 3 + bottom 3 performers, closing rate, and CSV attachment. Also create the cron SQL file.
steps: Create supabase/functions/weekly-sales-report/index.ts following the same structure as daily-sales-report (Deno.serve, corsHeaders, CRON_SECRET auth, Resend API, supabase client).
Time window: previous full week (Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC). Also fetch the week before that for week-over-week comparison.
Fetch lead_activities, follow_ups (done), leads (created), bookings (with profit) for both weeks, grouped by person.
Calculate per person: calls, emails, whatsapp, stage_moves, followups_done, new_leads, bookings, revenue, total_score.
Calculate closing_rate_percent = (bookings / new_leads * 100) per person. If no leads, 'N/A'.
Rank all people by total_score descending. Identify Top 3 and Bottom 3 performers.
Build ADMIN HTML: full team comparison table with all columns including closing rate, WoW improvement, rank. Highlight Top 3 (green) and Bottom 3 (red). Summary cards at top.
Build INDIVIDUAL HTML: each salesperson gets their own stats only, their rank among team, their WoW improvement, and how they compare to team average.
Generate CSV with columns: Person, Calls, Emails, WhatsApp, Stage_Moves, Followups_Done, New_Leads, Bookings, Revenue, Closing_Rate_Percent, Improvement_vs_Previous, Total_Score, Rank

Send admin email with full team CSV attachment. Send individual emails to each salesperson (from profiles + user_roles where role in ['sales','bd']) with their personal summary (no CSV for individuals, just HTML).

Create setup/ADD_WEEKLY_SALES_REPORT_CRON.sql - schedule for Monday 9 AM IST (3:30 AM UTC) = cron expression '30 3 * * 1'. Follow the exact same template as ADD_DAILY_SALES_REPORT_CRON.sql with placeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Admin receives full team report with rankings, top/bottom 3, and CSV attachment
Each salesperson receives their individual report via separate Resend call
Closing rate is included per person
setup/ADD_WEEKLY_SALES_REPORT_CRON.sql exists with Monday 3:30 AM UTC schedule
Same auth pattern (CRON_SECRET) as daily report
verification: Verify setup/ADD_WEEKLY_SALES_REPORT_CRON.sql has correct cron expression '30 3 * * 1'
Verify Resend payload includes attachments for admin email
Verify individual emails are sent in a loop to each sales/bd user
findings: Successfully created weekly-sales-report edge function and cron SQL. Build passes. No Deno runtime available locally so TypeScript was verified syntactically only. The function follows the exact same patterns as the daily-sales-report (CRON_SECRET auth, corsHeaders, Resend API, btoa for CSV encoding). Individual emails are sent in a loop for each sales/bd user.
